name: PawPair: Pet Care
subtitle: Private care for every pet
promotionalText: Organize routines, health records and reminders privately on iPhone and iPad. Add every pet and share clear caregiver handoffs with PawPair Premium.
description:
PawPair is a calm, private home for the everyday care and health history of every pet you love.

YOUR PET AT THE CENTER
Create a companion profile with a name, species, breed and optional medical identity details. PawPair gives each pet a warm visual presence and keeps the current companion at the heart of the experience.

A CLEAR DAILY RHYTHM
Plan meals, walks, water, medication and other care moments. See what is next, mark tasks complete and understand the day without turning care into another complicated system.

USEFUL HEALTH HISTORY
Keep local records for weight, vaccines, symptoms, medications and notes. Follow weight trends, distinguish ongoing symptoms from resolved ones and prepare a focused health passport when you choose. PawPair organizes information but never diagnoses.

LOCAL REMINDERS, ON YOUR TERMS
Choose whether to enable reminders. PawPair schedules notifications locally and asks for permission only after you opt in.

BACKUP WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Create an encrypted portable backup, restore it through the system file picker or share selected summaries through the native Share sheet. You stay in control of where exported files go.

PAWPAIR PREMIUM
Premium unlocks unlimited companion profiles and caregiver handoff tools. Monthly and annual auto-renewable options are available. PawPair displays the localized App Store price and only advertises a trial when eligibility can be verified.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
PawPair does not require an account for core care. Pet profiles, care history, health records and attachments remain on your device. If you opt in, PawPair sends anonymous product-interaction events and installation identifiers to its protected analytics project; pet details, care notes and health information are never included. There are no ads or cross-app tracking. Apple and RevenueCat process purchase status when Premium is viewed, purchased or restored.

BUILT FOR IPHONE & IPAD
PawPair supports adaptive layouts, accessible labels, comfortable touch targets and Reduce Motion.

PawPair is not veterinary advice, an emergency service or a substitute for a qualified veterinarian.
